data.name: Create New Payroll Batch
data.description:
Summary Description
The Pay Entry API allows API users to interface with Paylocity�s HR & Payroll module, specifically within the 'Run Payroll' feature. This API allows users to submit new payroll batches for a specified check date. The endpoint accepts summarized payroll data, allowing API users to import data from third-party systems.

Submits summarized payroll data as a new payroll batch for a specified check date. Use it to import payroll entries into Paylocity's Run Payroll feature.
Use for: create payroll batch, import payroll data, submit pay entries
Not supported: retrieving batches, editing employees, processing payments

data.name: GET /values/payrollInputsGroup/runCategories/
data.description:
Retrieves instances that can be used as values for other endpoint parameters in this service.
Secured by: Worker Data: Payroll Public API (Payroll Input)
Scope: Core Payroll
Parameters
| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| endDate | query | No | The end date for the positions, using the date format yyyy-mm-dd. |
| limit | query | No | The maximum number of objects in a single response. The default and maximum is 1000. |
| offset | query | No | The zero-based index of the first object in a response collection. The default is 0. Use offset with the limit parameter |
| payComponent | query | No | The pay component for the worktags. You can use a returned id from GET/values/payrollInputsGroup/payComponents. |
| search | query | No | A search string that matches display IDs. The search is case-insensitive and matches words that start with the given str |
| startDate | query | No | The start date for the positions, using the date format yyyy-mm-dd. |
| worker | query | No | The Workday ID of the worker. You can use a returned id from GET /workers in the Staffing service. |
Response Codes

200 Successful response. A successful response can return no matched data.
400 Invalid request. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)
401 Unauthorized: Missing or invalid credentials. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)
403 User has insufficient permissions. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)
404 Resource not found. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)

data.name: Sync - Payroll/Employees
data.description:
Sync endpoint to read Payroll Employees (optimized for synchronisation).
Documentation: https://start.exactonline.nl/docs/HlpRestAPIResources.aspx?SourceAction=10
Quick Start:
- GET /api/v1/{{division}}/sync/Payroll/Employees
Parameters Explained:
- division (path): Division identifier.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing/invalid token.
Edge Cases & Rate Limits:
- Sync endpoints return larger sets and are intended for full or delta sync flows.
data.evaluateGuide:
Reads payroll employee resources from Exact Online for synchronization, returning larger data sets for full or delta sync flows.
Use for: sync payroll employees, import employee records, run employee data sync
Not supported: creating employees, updating records, running payroll

data.name: Payroll - Employees (List / Get)
data.description:
Retrieves Employees (payroll employees) for a division or single Employee by id.
Documentation: https://start.exactonline.nl/docs/HlpRestAPIResourcesDetails.aspx?name=PayrollEmployees
Overview:
Employees returns payroll employee master records. Use the collection URL to list or query employees; use an id to fetch a single employee. (pkg.go.dev)
Quick Start:
- Acquire OAuth2 access token (Bearer). (docs.eponalegal.com)
- Call GET {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/{{division}}/payroll/Employees
Parameters:
- division (required): administration id.
- id (optional): GUID of an employee (use in resource path to get specific employee).
- $select, $filter, $top, $orderby, $expand - supported OData query options. (apideck.com)
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401: invalid token — renew token.
- 403: insufficient permissions — ensure user/app has payroll-related rights.
- 400: malformed query — check field names.
Edge Cases:
- Large result sets are paginated; follow d.__next or use $top and continuation tokens.
Rate Limits:
- Respect Exact Online minute and daily quotas (typical examples: 60/minute, 5,000/day). (barcodescan.nl)
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves payroll employee master records for an Exact Online division, or a single employee when an ID is supplied. Use it to read payroll employee data.
Use for: list employees, get employee by ID, query payroll employees
Not supported: creating employees, updating records, running payroll
